test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 4 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the correct pair of state and its corresponding classical dance form from the following.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kuchipudi: Andhra Pradesh.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kuchipudi** is native to the **state of Andhra Pradesh** and varies from the other five classical styles by the inclusion of singing.
 
• Kuchipudi arose in the** 17th century.**
 
• With the design by **Sidhyendra Yogi of the dance drama Bhama Kalapam**, a story of Satyabhāma, the charming but jealous wife of the god Krishna.
 
• Kuchipudi is a dance-drama presentation, with its roots in the old** Hindu Sanskrit text of Natya Shastra.**
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f44bb6c55d49362ec89babe14fbf914c10e594329ecefb9b3d6801750c089edc.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kathakali or 'story play**' arose in **Kerala in southern India** in the seventeenth century under the patronage of the** prince of Karnataka.**
 
• **Bharatanatyam** is a classical dance of **Tamil Nadu **in southern India.
 
• **Manipuri** is an old classical dance form that originated in the northeastern state of** Manipur in India.​** 

10b
